title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Kids in the dugout
hook: What are the kids in your dugout doing right now?
intro: Four players sit in the dugout.
Two are talking about video games.
statement: The dugout is part of the team, too.
q1: Do you give dugout players something to watch for —
q2: or let them rest and cheer?
q3: What could they notice from the dugout?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But dugout players stay ready
t2: when they have a job while they wait.
cta: Coaches — how do you engage the dugout?
ctaLines: Watch your position. Count pitches. Lead the cheers.
ctaPrompt: Share your dugout habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What are the kids in your dugout doing right now?
Four players sit in the dugout. Two are talking about video games.
The dugout is part of the team, too.
Give them a job or let them rest. There is no single right way.
How do you engage the dugout? Share your habit in the comments.
